episodes.title: No Place Like Home
episodes.summary: Bea Smith goes from housewife to inmate and finds out the hard way that retribution in prison has fatal consequences.

episodes.title: Fly Me Away
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the riot, Will blackmails Doreen into helping him and Bea is given no choice but to continue to lie.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Waited
episodes.summary: Bea is caught up in the brutal rivalry between Franky and Jacs while Erica struggles to gain the support of the officers.

episodes.title: The Things We Do
episodes.summary: Franky teaches Bea a tough lesson while Liz struggles with old demons, Franky stirs up new feelings in Erica.

episodes.title: The Velvet Curtain
episodes.summary: Erica can't escape her feelings for Franky and Bea reveals the truth about her marriage to Liz.

episodes.title: Captive
episodes.summary: Vera's attempt to impress Fletch backfires and her domineering mother reveals a humiliating secret to her peers, while Erica betrays Franky.

episodes.title: Something Dies
episodes.summary: Bea pays a high price for crossing Jacs while Franky gets her revenge, and Will reverts to his old ways.

episodes.title: Mind Games
episodes.summary: To gain back control of Wentworth Jacs makes a final play to break Bea.

episodes.title: To the Moon
episodes.summary: Bea is buoyed by the inmate's support, while Jacs's power further diminishes and Vera and Fletch's date comes to a humiliating end.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.summary: The truth behind the riot is finally revealed and Bea confronts a killer leading to deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Born Again
episodes.summary: Three months after Jacs' death, new arrival Joan Ferguson makes an enemy of Franky, while Bea discovers a new purpose.

episodes.title: Whatever It Takes
episodes.summary: Bea attempts to get revenge on Brayden by goading Harry into an act of violence, whilst Franky's determination to maintain power pushes her to extreme lengths.

episodes.title: Boys in the Yard
episodes.summary: Following the failure of Harry to avenge their daughter's death, Bea hatches a daring plot to lure Brayden Holt to the jail.

episodes.title: The Danger Within
episodes.summary: Bea faces down an assassination attempt from the Holt clan.

episodes.title: Twist the Knife
episodes.summary: Bea discovers Simmo has a weakness she can exploit for her own ends. Meanwhile Fletch and Will face off in a confrontation that will end their friendship for good.

episodes.title: The Pink Dragon
episodes.summary: Simmo's attempt to kill Bea ends in tragedy, while Liz faces her greatest dilemma - to snitch or not to snitch.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.summary: When Ferguson psychologically manipulates Vera she crosses a point of no return whilst Maxine orchestrates a desperate bid to see her spurned lover.

episodes.title: Sins of the Mother
episodes.summary: An isolated and paranoid Franky tries to uncover which inmate is leaking vital information to Ferguson.

episodes.title: The Fixer
episodes.summary: When Ferguson discovers Doreen is the pregnant prisoner, the Governor threatens to have Nash's parole revoked unless she lies about the father. Will is publicly accused of an inappropriate relationship with Bea.

episodes.title: Jail Birds
episodes.summary: Liz struggles to adjust to life on the outside and tries to reconnect with her estranged children. Meanwhile, Derek Channing tries to build his case against Ferguson.

episodes.title: Into the Night
episodes.summary: As Bea and Franky go to war for control of the prison, Bea puts her daring plan in motion. Meanwhile, Fletch is on a downward spiral of self-destructive behaviour as his final day at Wentworth looms.

episodes.title: Fear Her
episodes.summary: The extent of Bea's plan is revealed as she makes the final moves to avenge Debbie's death. Meanwhile, Franky realises she is losing the support of the women and is forced to consider a deal.

episodes.title: The Governor's Pleasure
episodes.summary: When Bea is sentenced to life without parole for the killing of Brayden Holt, Ferguson makes it very clear she now owns Bea, setting up a battle for control of the prison.

episodes.title: Failing Upwards
episodes.summary: To cement her position as Top Dog, Bea makes a dangerous bargain with Ferguson.

episodes.title: Knives Out
episodes.summary: Franky's in trouble with her supply cut and her powerbase decimated, she's on her own when prisoners come after her to claim what they're owed.

episodes.title: Righteous Acts
episodes.summary: Liz's world is rocked with the arrival of a new prisoner. Franky commences her sessions with Bridget, and admits to a desire for revenge against Bea.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.summary: As Fletch makes a difficult return to work at Wentworth, he is troubled by an incident that leads him to suspect his accident was no accident at all.

episodes.title: Evidence
episodes.summary: Ferguson is blindsided by Jodie's complaint to the ombudsman. Channing attempts damage control, but Jodie's accusations of brutality promise to be very damaging for the Governor.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.summary: Bea is held in the psych unit and struggles to accept she had a psychotic episode. Franky is pushed to reveal her biggest secret.

episodes.title: Goldfish
episodes.summary: When Bea encourages Doreen to uncover the truth behind Ferguson's obsession with Jianna, Ferguson's renewed interest in Doreen brings on labour.

episodes.title: Freak Show
episodes.summary: Vera's faith in her Governor is put to the test. Meanwhile, Bea finds herself at her lowest ebb as she realises her war against Ferguson is having an effect on those closest to her.

episodes.title: A Higher Court
episodes.summary: Franky's parole hearing is brought forward but will she be granted a release? Meanwhile, Doreen faces an agonising choice.

episodes.title: The Living and the Dead
episodes.summary: When Bea uses her alliance with Fletch to drive a wedge between Vera and Ferguson, her actions set in motion an unstoppable chain of events.

episodes.title: Blood and Fire
episodes.summary: Ferguson is losing control, and the walls are closing in. Fletch and Vera band together in an attempt to overthrow the Governor, while Bea discovers the final piece of the puzzle to help solve Harry's murder.

episodes.title: First Blood
episodes.summary: The women return to Wentworth after the rebuild and a new dynamic is in play, which will have immediate ramifications for Bea who questions whether she wants to be Top Dog. Ferguson plans her next move.

episodes.title: Poking Spiders
episodes.summary: Ferguson launches a campaign to be released into the general prison population regardless of her peril and Kaz organises for the inmates to protest for conjugal visits.

episodes.title: Prisoner
episodes.summary: Ferguson is released into general and the pressure is on Bea to take revenge as the women are out for blood.

episodes.title: Screw Lover
episodes.summary: Ferguson strengthens her alliance with Kaz by painting Will as an abuser and Bea as a screw-lover, while Maxine receives a devastating diagnosis.

episodes.title: Love and Hate
episodes.summary: With Bea in the slot, Ferguson seeks to strengthen her hold over Kaz by manipulating acting Top Dog, Maxine into an act of extreme violence. Bea and Ally's bond grows.

episodes.title: Divide and Conquer
episodes.summary: When a young Koori inmate Tasha is subjected to prison justice for pushing the panic button, Doreen shocks everyone by turning her back on Bea.

episodes.title: Panic Button
episodes.summary: Vera and Ferguson battle for control of the women, using Bea and Kaz as their pawns.

episodes.title: Plan Bea
episodes.summary: Exploiting her knowledge of Bea's relationship with Allie, Ferguson engineers a plan to murder Bea.

episodes.title: Afterlife
episodes.summary: Bea struggles to recover in the wake of her attack. Ferguson returns from the burns unit and is placed in a medical hold under the supervision of Jake.

episodes.title: Smitten
episodes.summary: Bea discovers Allie has fallen back into drug addiction. Franky pursues Shayne in the hope of exposing Ferguson's plan to undermine her trial and secure her release from Wentworth.

episodes.title: Eleventh Hour
episodes.summary: When Bea commits to the ultimate sin of lagging to protect Allie, Kaz seizes on it to force Bea to step down as Top Dog, and Ferguson strikes again.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.summary: Bea awakes blissfully happy after a night with Allie but it is the eve of Ferguson's trial and the Freak has been relentless in putting the final touches to her scheme for freedom and exoneration.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.summary: Vera and Ferguson must deal with the fallout from the attack on Bea and Franky's past comes back to haunt her.

episodes.title: The Bitch is Back
episodes.summary: Liz starts to regret her decision to testify against Sonia; Vera takes desperate measures to foil Ferguson's self-defence plea; Franky's trapped by her past.

episodes.title: Nothing But the Truth
episodes.summary: Liz takes the stand as the mystery witness at Sonia's trial, while Franky and Bridget struggle to keep their relationship together.

episodes.title: Loose Ends
episodes.summary: While Liz languishes back in Wentworth waiting for Don to come to her rescue, Sonia is a free woman, and Franky plans her escape.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: Franky's escape plan could have fatal consequences and Liz is forced to take drastic measures to protect herself.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Vera
episodes.summary: The women become frustrated with the Top Dog's lack of action against Lucy, and Vera receives a birthday present she will never forget.

episodes.title: The Pact
episodes.summary: Allie attempts to take out Ferguson and Will sets a trap to bust the drug ring.

episodes.title: Think Inside the Box
episodes.summary: Franky's escape plan derails her relationship with Bridget, Sonia unleashes on Liz, and Will makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Snakehead
episodes.summary: Will sets out to expose Jake, forcing Vera to make a choice; Franky engages help from the outside, while the net tightens around Liz.

episodes.title: Mere Anarchy
episodes.summary: Franky faces danger from an unexpected source, Ferguson pulls strings to sideline Vera, and Liz goes to extreme lengths to try to get a confession from Sonia.

episodes.title: Coup De Grace
episodes.summary: Ferguson delivers Vera her coup de grace, unleashing unforeseen consequences; Franky's escape plans are waylaid when Kaz persuades her to join forces to bring down the Freak.

episodes.title: Hell Bent
episodes.summary: Franky and Allie put their escape plan into action, Liz takes desperate measures to protect herself, and Ferguson suspects she's living on borrowed time.

episodes.title: Clean Slate
episodes.summary: Franky is on the run. Vera is determined to prove that Jake helped Ferguson break out. New arrival Rita Connors has her sights set on reconciliation with someone from her past.

episodes.title: The Boxer
episodes.summary: Sonia returns from near death, hell bent on revenge against her poisoner. Boomer sets the cat among the pigeons when she implicates Liz.

episodes.title: Bleed Out
episodes.summary: After being shot Franky seeks Bridget's help, but the police net is tightening. Meanwhile, Kaz faces her toughest challenge when she warns Hutch to stop fight club.

episodes.title: Winter is Here
episodes.summary: Marie Winter arrives in Wentworth. Sonia will go to any length to reopen her Green Wall workshop. Meanwhile, Will is haunted by what he has done to Ferguson and Jake scrambles to stop him from flipping out.

episodes.title: Bitter Pill
episodes.summary: Vera finds herself under added pressure at work when the press criticise her reopening of the workshop. When Jake saves Liz's life in a selfless act, Vera is forced to reassess her opinion of him.

episodes.title: Angel of Wentworth
episodes.summary: As Sonia tries to spin her 'Angel of Wentworth' PR into an innocence campaign, her past crimes threaten to derail her - and it could be fatal.

episodes.title: The Edge
episodes.summary: When Sonia is refused a move into Protection, she sets up a plan to discredit Kaz and invalidate her position as top dog. With Marie onside, the plan is underway - but may have terrible repercussions for Allie.

episodes.title: Lovers and Fighters
episodes.summary: Kaz is released from the slot and the women soon realise she has profoundly changed. Becoming Liz's protector, Kaz also demonstrates a harder, tougher top doggedness.

episodes.title: Shallow Grave
episodes.summary: Rita is caught in a trap set by Marie and Drago, and must compromise Ray in order to maintain her cover, while Ruby questions Allie's loyalty when she believes her to be spying for Marie.

episodes.title: Fractured
episodes.summary: Marie discovers that Liz may have witnessed the attack on Cherry Li. Realising that Liz is ill and vulnerable, she takes advantage of her condition and convinces her that Boomer was responsible.

episodes.title: Indelible Ink
episodes.summary: Allie learns that Marie is getting surveillance photographs smuggled in that show the attack on her son, and Ruby panics.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.summary: A shocked Vera finally discovers the identity of her stalker, who has one last ultimatum. Liz has a daunting favour to ask of Kaz.

episodes.title: Blood Wedding
episodes.summary: The prison is on tenterhooks as the war between Marie and Rita goes over the edge, after Rita has spent a very long time in isolation, she's out for revenge and so is Marie. With her hopes of release fading, Rita is forced to take drastic measures to prevent Ray from wasting his life on her.

episodes.title: Payback
episodes.summary: Rita and Kaz form an alliance to bring down Marie, while Jake's jealously toward Vera is apparent as she forms a bond with a new colleague. Whilst a new acting deputy is voted in, it's someone we would least expect it to be.

episodes.title: Atonement
episodes.summary: Kaz is sent to isolation for everyone else's safety, while a new prisoner arrives and is a blast from Rita's past, as the prison spirals out of control, Will and Linda both struggle in their new positions to get on top of the drugs problem.

episodes.title: Karen
episodes.summary: Vera learns the sex of her baby whilst Marie and Kaz try and make amends, with Rita facing an impossible dilemma to keep her identity as a former cop a secret after being told to kill Kaz by the new inmate.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.summary: The Prisoners and Staff mourn the loss of their Top Dog, while the hunt is on for the person who murdered her. Tensions remain very high as the investigation into the death stir up emotions for everyone.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.summary: The Prisoners tensions are still extremely high as questions start to be answered about what happened. Boomer has some long awaited catching up to do, but her day release is short-lived. Marie discovers that Ruby killed her son, Danny.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: As Ruby undergoes surgery for the ruptured brain aneurysm, Rita makes a desperate appeal to Vera to be with her sister in hospital.

episodes.title: Protection
episodes.summary: Marie's efforts to have her conviction overturned backfire when her protector attempts to silence her permanently. Meanwhile, Liz summons the courage to meet with her estranged son.

episodes.title: Under Siege (1)
episodes.summary: Marie enacts her plan to bust out of Wentworth while Liz spirals into a psychotic meltdown.

episodes.title: Under Siege (2)
episodes.summary: In this shocking season finale, the prison is still under siege, and not everyone will make it out alive.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.summary: The prison starts to rebuild after the siege but many of the prisoners and officers struggle to cope with memories. The General Manager deals with Will's mismanagement of the siege.

episodes.title: Ends and Means
episodes.summary: Marie makes a desperate, last-ditch attempt to avenge her son.

episodes.title: Enemy of the State
episodes.summary: Young British ‘Wikileaker' Judy Bryant is remanded to Wentworth facing charges of stealing secrets from the Australian government. Is she a hero of the people, or an enemy of the state.

episodes.title: Revenant
episodes.summary: The news of Ferguson's survival rocks Wentworth.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.summary: Judy makes an enemy of Ann Reynolds, but enables Ruby to finally get in touch with Rita.

episodes.title: Fugitive
episodes.summary: Rita sacrifices her hope of exoneration to rescue Ruby.

episodes.title: Battle Lines
episodes.summary: A desperate Judy seeks her father's help, but his callous rejection pushes Judy to commit a vicious act.

episodes.title: Goldfish, Part 2
episodes.summary: With the prison in lockdown, tensions reach crisis point. Reb loses it with Miller, Lou presses Ferguson to commit an act of evil, and Allie and Ferguson face life-changing choices.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: Reb and Lou are rocked by a blast from the past with cult leader Sheila coming into the compound. Ferguson awaits news of her committal hearing as Vera enlists Allie to help her with devastating consequences.

episodes.title: The Enemy Within
episodes.summary: Believing Allie stole their phone and money, Lou threatens her to return the money or face the consequences. Meanwhile, Sheila offers to pay for Reb's surgery.

episodes.title: Rogue
episodes.summary: When the gates of Wentworth Correctional Centre open on the final season, three weeks have passed since the shivving of Allie. With Allie's attacker still at large, no one, least of all the H1 family, realise that they have a terrorist and would-be murderer, Judy Bryant, in their midst.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.summary: Marie and Lou become unlikely allies, while retribution for Reb's life comes at a deadly price.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.summary: Boomer faces a crisis of courage when she takes on Lou for top dog and Judy convinces Allie to help with her bid for extradition.

episodes.title: Judas Kiss
episodes.summary: Allie plans her revenge against Lou, while a former nemesis of Ferguson enters Wentworth.

episodes.title: The Unknown Terrorist
episodes.summary: Allie takes a risk to reveal Judy's identity as the murderous traitor; Judy's fate lies in the outcome of a war council held by the H1 family.

episodes.title: One Eye Open
episodes.summary: Lou takes over the escape plan; Ferguson continues to manipulate Eve in her revenge plan on Jake, and Marie discovers Rita is a cop.

episodes.title: Collateral
episodes.summary: Vera and Will want to bring down Miller but severe consequences are made when a code blue is called. While Rita fears her past will be revealed as its only a matter of time. While Boomer and Gavin get hot under the collar.

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.summary: Vera's battle with Ferguson pushes her to the edge of a moral abyss and Rita turns up the heat on Judy, seeing her as the weak link.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Rita's exposure as a cop, the family fights for survival while Ann continues to unravel.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.summary: The day of reckoning has arrived and Lou plans on going out with a bang. A battle for survival ensues amongst staff and inmates whilst one last conflict rises from the ashes. What lies ahead for the beloved H-block crew?
